verdict.rationale: stagewise's agent can read, write, and modify workspace files, run shell commands, scripts, and package managers, and orchestrate multi-step workflows. That generic toolset plausibly covers test writing, lint fixing, and dependency updates via package managers, and edits can be reviewed through inline diffs. None of the four tasks is explicitly documented, though, and the product's positioning is centered on visual/UI front-end work. missing for 10: explicit test-generation support, lint-error fixing workflows, merge-conflict resolution, dependency-update features, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of these tasks.
